done_when: The owner switches a repo to agent merges with one command run in their own terminal

findings.body: The replacement recognizes only an unquoted `merge` at column one. A valid `forge.toml` containing `  merge = "human"` or `"merge" = "human"` passes Forge's TOML parser, but this code inserts a second root key. It commits invalid TOML, so `forge close` cannot finish the switch.
findings.title: Handle valid indented or quoted merge keys

findings.body: This check sees only local branches. If `origin/fix/let-the-agent-merge` belongs to another fix but has no local branch, `forge merge enable` creates and commits a new local fix before its push fails. A rerun repeats the failed push. The existing fix-start path checks remote refs too (`src/forge/task.py:226-227`).
findings.title: Check for an existing remote switch branch before creating a worktree

findings.body: A differently named fix that changes `merge` can reach Ready in a prototype. `forge close` correctly assigns its pull request to a human, but this condition uses the prototype's effective agent setting and tells the user to run `forge merge <item>`. That command then refuses the setting change. The prototype override is in `src/forge/repo.py:174-177`.
findings.title: Keep forge next on the owner path for other merge-setting fixes

findings.body: `_enable` requires both `why` and `done_when` to recognize its fix (`src/forge/merge.py:174`), but `forge next` checks only `why`. A normal fix started with the same why and a different done-when is treated as the switch: at Started, its next step points to `forge merge enable`, which creates or resumes a different fix.
findings.title: Identify the switch fix by its full recorded contract in forge next

findings.body: `forge fix start "Enable" --done ...` can create the valid item `fix/enable` through the existing slug logic (`src/forge/task.py:223-235`). Its `forge merge enable` invocation now always enters the switch command, so Forge can no longer merge that ready fix through its item command.
findings.title: Preserve merging an existing fix named enable

why: Nothing in the flow can switch a repo to agent merges: Forge tells the owner to ask the agent, and the agent's own permission checks rightly refuse to loosen a gate on itself
